fields.name: extension
fields.description: File extension without a leading dot, such as mp4.

fields.name: media_type
fields.description:
Media type used to validate extension and build the object path.

Allowed values:
- `MEDIA_TYPE_UNDEFINED` - Not specified.
- `VIDEO` - Video file, such as mp4.
- `AUDIO` - Audio file, such as mp3.
- `IMAGE` - Image file, such as png.
- `DOCUMENT` - Document file, such as md or docx.

fields.name: code
fields.description:
Application response code.

| Code | Meaning |
| ---- | ------- |
| `0` | OK |
| `12` | Invalid input |
| `13` | Authentication is required |
| `16` | Rate limit exceeded |
| `99` | Server error |

fields.name: data.content_type
fields.description: Content-Type expected by the direct upload request.

fields.name: data.file
fields.description: File reference to pass into later media APIs.

fields.name: data.upload_url
fields.description: Pre-signed URL the client should upload the file to.
